terra.problem: The Pharisees and their scribes complained to the disciples about their eating and drinking with tax collectors and sinners; the verses do not say they complained about Jesus eating with sinners.
They contrast His disciples’ eating and drinking with others’ fasting and prayer, but do not explicitly ask why His disciples do not fast.
